payload.description_html:
Bones of Troodon validus (Lambe). No.2, Univ. of Alberta. Fig. I-Right scapula. Lateral view. Natural size. Fig. 2-Right humerus. Anterior view. Natural size. Fig. il-Right coracoid. Lateral view. Natural size. Fig. 4-Right ulna. Lateral view. Natural size. Fig. 5-Right radius. Front view. Natural size. Fig. 6-Metatarsal IV, right anterior view. Three-fourths natural size. Fig. 7-Metatarsal I right, lateral view. Three-fourths natural size. Fig. 8-Distal end of Phu.Ianx, Right pes. Dorsal view. Natural size. Fig. 9-Median phalanx digit IV, right pes. Dorsal view. Natural size. Fig 10.-Distal phalanx digit (1) IV, right pes. Dorsal view. Natural size.

Fig. ll-Ungual phalanx. Dorsal view'. Natural size.
